what: After each year's governor races, once their results have settled and Wikipedia has every race's result: adds them and their polls to the training data, refits the model and remakes the back-tests. Between elections it finds nothing to do, which counts as working.
how_to_read: ok false: the last run failed, error says why, and the site keeps the last good figures. ok true but today later than overdue_after: the job has stopped running. The workflow link lists every run.
